name: jurisdiction_id
description: Identifier of the jurisdiction, in the form state_place, e.g. ca_san_diego or tx_statewide
observations: Taken from the source file name

name: state_abbreviation
description: Two-letter postal abbreviation of the state

name: state_id
description: Two-digit FIPS code of the state
observations: Added by Data Basis from state_abbreviation

name: jurisdiction_name
description: Name of the place, or Statewide for a state patrol
observations: As named in the project's README

name: jurisdiction_type
description: Type of agency: city (municipal police department) or statewide (state patrol)

name: release_date
description: Date of the project's data release the file comes from
observations: 2020-04-01 for most jurisdictions; 2023-01-26 for the 12 refreshed in the 2023 update

name: start_date
description: Date of the earliest stop in the jurisdiction's file
observations: Computed by Data Basis. A few jurisdictions have isolated records decades before their main coverage

name: end_date
description: Date of the latest stop in the jurisdiction's file

name: number_stops
description: Number of stops in the jurisdiction's file

name: source_url
description: URL of the source CSV file
